requirement: - **The raid** *(V5)*. Trading three Raids, the seat chooses **any enemy country**, anywhere on the board. That stack is replaced by a whole number drawn uniformly from 1 to half its armies, rounded down (at least 1): 9 becomes 1 to 4, 40 becomes 1 to 20. A 1-army stack is unchanged. Ownership does not change, and the raiding seat's pool is unchanged.

requirement: - **Counter-play.** A raid needs a set of three, so it is rare and its build-up can be watched: hand counts are public. A Shield stops one. Distance does not protect a stack, and the loss grows with the stack (half or more of it), so one huge stack is the most exposed; several medium stacks lose less to any one raid.
